# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On January 4, 2024, LTC Properties, Inc. (a Maryland corporation) entered into a Second Amendment to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Bank of Montreal as Administrative Agent and L/C Issuer, along with a syndicate of lenders including Citizens Bank, KeyBank National Association, The Huntington National Bank, and Wells Fargo Bank.
- LTC Properties, Inc. serves as the Borrower in this revolving credit facility arrangement.
- The original Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement was dated November 19, 2021, with a First Amendment executed on December 19, 2022.
- The purpose of this Second Amendment is to modify Section 2.16 of the Credit Agreement, which governs extension options for the Stated Revolving Credit Termination Date. The amendment allows the Borrower to request a one-year extension of the facility, subject to certain conditions including no existing defaults, compliance with representations and warranties, and payment of an Extension Fee.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
- Strong banking syndicate comprising well-established financial institutions (Bank of Montreal, Citizens Bank, KeyBank, Huntington National Bank, Wells Fargo), indicating broad lender confidence
- Borrower represents that no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing under the Credit Agreement
- Amendment provides structural flexibility by allowing for potential maturity extension, demonstrating ongoing lender support
- All existing loan documents and security arrangements remain in full force and effect

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
- Limited financial information available to assess underlying credit quality or financial performance of LTC Properties
- Extension option requires payment of an Extension Fee, though the amount is not specified in the available documentation

(a Maryland corporation) entered into a Second Amendment to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Bank of Montreal as Administrative Agent and L/C Issuer, along with a syndicate of lenders including Citizens Bank, KeyBank National Association, The Huntington National Bank, and Wells Fargo Bank.
- LTC Properties, Inc. serves as the Borrower in this revolving credit facility arrangement.
- The original Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement was dated November 19, 2021, with a First Amendment executed on December 19, 2022.
- The purpose of this Second Amendment is to modify Section 2.16 of the Credit Agreement, which governs extension options for the Stated Revolving Credit Termination Date. - Borrower represents that no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing under the Credit Agreement
- Amendment provides structural flexibility by allowing for potential maturity extension, demonstrating ongoing lender support
- All existing loan documents and security arrangements remain in full force and effect

- Limited financial information available to assess underlying credit quality or financial performance of LTC Properties
- Extension option requires payment of an Extension Fee, though the amount is not specified in the available documentation
- Amendment only addresses maturity extension mechanics without visibility into other key credit terms such as pricing, covenants, or facility size
